sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fp.posting_key) AS listings_mentioning_python_and_sql FROM fct_posting AS fp JOIN posting_skills AS ps_python ON fp.posting_key = ps_python.posting_key JOIN posting_skills AS ps_sql ON fp.posting_key = ps_sql.posting_key WHERE fp.is_open = TRUE AND fp.remote_us = TRUE AND fp.is_canonical_listing = TRUE AND ps_python.skill = 'python' AND ps_sql.skill = 'sql'
